paragraphs.source_en: On the morning of the sixteenth day of the ninth month in the fifth year of Keichō, the rain had still not stopped.

units.source_en: On the morning of the sixteenth day of the ninth month in the fifth year of Keichō, the rain had still not stopped.

ja.t: はまだやんでいなかった。

units.source_zh: 庆长五年九月十六，晨，雨还没停。

paragraphs.source_zh: 庆长五年九月十六，晨，雨还没停。

paragraphs.source_en: Upon waking at Zuiryūji Temple, Tokugawa Ieyasu immediately returned to Fujikawadai, ordered the battlefield cleared and graves built for the dead, and did not set out for Sawayama Castle until nearly noon.

units.source_en: Upon waking at Zuiryūji Temple, Tokugawa Ieyasu immediately returned to Fujikawadai, ordered the battlefield cleared and graves built for the dead, and did not set out for Sawayama Castle until nearly noon.
units.source_zh: 德川家康在瑞龙寺一觉醒来，立刻返回藤川台，命人清扫战场，并为死者筑坟，将近午时才开赴佐和山城。

paragraphs.source_zh: 德川家康在瑞龙寺一觉醒来，立刻返回藤川台，命人清扫战场，并为死者筑坟，将近午时才开赴佐和山城。

paragraphs.source_en: Sawayama Castle stood east of Hikone, on a mountain beside Lake Biwa. The commanders Kobayakawa, Wakizaka, Kutsuki, and Tanaka Yoshimasa, who had arrived ahead of him, had already surrounded it completely.

units.source_en: Sawayama Castle stood east of Hikone, on a mountain beside Lake Biwa.
units.source_zh: 佐和山城位于彦根东，在琵琶湖畔的一座山上。

units.source_en: The commanders Kobayakawa, Wakizaka, Kutsuki, and Tanaka Yoshimasa, who had arrived ahead of him, had already surrounded it completely.
units.source_zh: 先行到达的小早川、胁坂、朽木和田中吉政诸将，早就将其团团围住。

paragraphs.source_zh: 佐和山城位于彦根东，在琵琶湖畔的一座山上。先行到达的小早川、胁坂、朽木和田中吉政诸将，早就将其团团围住。

paragraphs.source_en: Those now holed up in Sawayama Castle included Ishida Mitsunari's father, Oki-no-kami Masatsugu; his elder brother, Moku-no-kami Masazumi; Masazumi's son, Ukon Tomonari; Mitsunari's son, Hayato-no-shō Shigeie; and Mitsunari's father-in-law, Ukita Shimotsuke-no-kami Yoritada. Disaster was upon them.

units.source_en: Those now holed up in Sawayama Castle included Ishida Mitsunari's father, Oki-no-kami Masatsugu; his elder brother, Moku-no-kami Masazumi; Masazumi's son, Ukon Tomonari; Mitsunari's son, Hayato-no-shō Shigeie; and Mitsunari's father-in-law, Ukita Shimotsuke-no-kami Yoritada.
units.source_zh: 如今，龟缩在佐和山城中的，有石田三成之父隐岐守正继、兄木工头正澄、正澄子右近朝成、三成之子隼人正重家、三成岳父宇喜多下野守赖忠诸人。

units.source_en: Disaster was upon them.
units.source_zh: 他们大难临头了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 如今，龟缩在佐和山城中的，有石田三成之父隐岐守正继、兄木工头正澄、正澄子右近朝成、三成之子隼人正重家、三成岳父宇喜多下野守赖忠诸人。他们大难临头了。

paragraphs.source_en: As soon as Ieyasu reached Sawayama, he sent an envoy to urge the defenders to surrender. The siege proceeded with remarkable ease because Hasegawa Gunbei Moritomo, sent from Osaka Castle to reinforce Sawayama, deserted to the other side after being won over by Hiraoka Yorikatsu, a senior retainer of Kobayakawa Hideaki.

units.source_en: As soon as Ieyasu reached Sawayama, he sent an envoy to urge the defenders to surrender.
units.source_zh: 一赶到佐和山，家康就派人前去劝降。

units.source_en: The siege proceeded with remarkable ease because Hasegawa Gunbei Moritomo, sent from Osaka Castle to reinforce Sawayama, deserted to the other side after being won over by Hiraoka Yorikatsu, a senior retainer of Kobayakawa Hideaki.
units.source_zh: 由于大坂城派来支援佐和山的长谷川郡兵卫守知，在小早川秀秋家老平冈赖胜的策反下弃暗投明，攻城异常顺利。

paragraphs.source_zh: 一赶到佐和山，家康就派人前去劝降。由于大坂城派来支援佐和山的长谷川郡兵卫守知，在小早川秀秋家老平冈赖胜的策反下弃暗投明，攻城异常顺利。

paragraphs.source_en: First the main gate fell, and then Kobayakawa's troops surged into the castle. Ii Naomasa had no choice but to act on his own authority and send an envoy into the castle to urge surrender. Masazumi immediately replied from within: “My father, Ukita Shimotsuke-no-kami, and I will come outside the castle and commit seppuku. Spare the lives of the others.”

units.source_en: First the main gate fell, and then Kobayakawa's troops surged into the castle.
units.source_zh: 首先是正门失陷，接着小早川的人马突入城内。

units.source_en: Ii Naomasa had no choice but to act on his own authority and send an envoy into the castle to urge surrender.
units.source_zh: 井伊直政只得自作主张，派使者进城劝降。

units.source_en: Masazumi immediately replied from within: “My father, Ukita Shimotsuke-no-kami, and I will come outside the castle and commit seppuku.
units.source_zh: 城内的正澄立刻答复道：“我和父亲、宇喜多下野守三人到城外切腹。

units.source_en: Spare the lives of the others.”
units.source_zh: 望留得他人性命。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 首先是正门失陷，接着小早川的人马突入城内。井伊直政只得自作主张，派使者进城劝降。城内的正澄立刻答复道：“我和父亲、宇喜多下野守三人到城外切腹。望留得他人性命。”

paragraphs.source_en: Naomasa immediately reported this to Ieyasu. Ieyasu had never truly intended to storm the castle, so he readily agreed: “Very well. Have Murakoshi Mosuke take possession of it.”

units.source_en: Naomasa immediately reported this to Ieyasu.
units.source_zh: 直政立刻禀告了家康。

units.source_en: Ieyasu had never truly intended to storm the castle, so he readily agreed: “Very well.

ja.t: めるつもりではなかったので、

units.source_zh: 家康从一开始就未真心攻城，遂痛快答应：“好。

units.source_en: Have Murakoshi Mosuke take possession of it.”
units.source_zh: 就让村越茂助去接收城池。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 直政立刻禀告了家康。家康从一开始就未真心攻城，遂痛快答应：“好。就让村越茂助去接收城池。”

paragraphs.source_en: By then it was already the morning of the eighteenth.

units.source_en: By then it was already the morning of the eighteenth.
units.source_zh: 此时已是十八日晨。

paragraphs.source_zh: 此时已是十八日晨。

paragraphs.source_en: But before Ieyasu's order could be relayed throughout the army, a detachment under Tanaka Yoshimasa had already forced its way through the rear gate. At the sight of this, Moku-no-kami Masazumi ground his teeth in fury. He was convinced that Ieyasu had deceived him. By the time Murakoshi Mosuke arrived, the castle was already a sea of flames. Masazumi had scattered gunpowder throughout the castle and set it ablaze, then led his entire clan up into the keep.

units.source_en: But before Ieyasu's order could be relayed throughout the army, a detachment under Tanaka Yoshimasa had already forced its way through the rear gate.
units.source_zh: 但还没等家康的命令传达全军，田中吉政的一彪人马已攻入了后门。

units.source_en: At the sight of this, Moku-no-kami Masazumi ground his teeth in fury.
units.source_zh: 见此情景，木工头正澄不禁恨得咬牙切齿。

units.source_en: He was convinced that Ieyasu had deceived him.
units.source_zh: 他深信自己被家康骗了。

units.source_en: By the time Murakoshi Mosuke arrived, the castle was already a sea of flames.
units.source_zh: 村越茂助赶到时，城内已是一片火海。

units.source_en: Masazumi had scattered gunpowder throughout the castle and set it ablaze, then led his entire clan up into the keep.
units.source_zh: 原来，正澄在城内遍洒火药，大放其火，然后带领合族人登上了天守阁。

paragraphs.source_zh: 但还没等家康的命令传达全军，田中吉政的一彪人马已攻入了后门。见此情景，木工头正澄不禁恨得咬牙切齿。他深信自己被家康骗了。村越茂助赶到时，城内已是一片火海。原来，正澄在城内遍洒火药，大放其火，然后带领合族人登上了天守阁。

paragraphs.source_en: The residence of Ishida Mitsunari, once celebrated in the “Song of Sawayama Castle,” was reduced to ashes in an instant. Before the castle burned, someone had sung of it thus:

units.source_en: The residence of Ishida Mitsunari, once celebrated in the “Song of Sawayama Castle,” was reduced to ashes in an instant.
units.source_zh: 这座人们曾在《佐和山城歌》中吟唱过的石田三成的居城，顷刻间化为灰烬。

units.source_en: Before the castle burned, someone had sung of it thus:
units.source_zh: 这座居城未焚前，有人歌之曰：

paragraphs.source_zh: 这座人们曾在《佐和山城歌》中吟唱过的石田三成的居城，顷刻间化为灰烬。这座居城未焚前，有人歌之曰：

paragraphs.source_en: > A traveler comes from Kyoto, drawing rein at Sawayama.

units.source_en: > A traveler comes from Kyoto, drawing rein at Sawayama.
units.source_zh: > 客自京都来，顿辔佐和山。

paragraphs.source_zh: > 客自京都来，顿辔佐和山。

paragraphs.source_en: > Soaring eaves outshine the sunset clouds; eightfold bands of white encircle them.

units.source_en: > Soaring eaves outshine the sunset clouds; eightfold bands of white encircle them.
units.source_zh: > 飞甍夺余霞，外绕八重练。

paragraphs.source_zh: > 飞甍夺余霞，外绕八重练。

paragraphs.source_en: > Gazing upward toward the lofty tower, one beholds its ornate windows from afar.

units.source_en: > Gazing upward toward the lofty tower, one beholds its ornate windows from afar.
units.source_zh: > 引领高阁上，绮疏遥相瞻。

paragraphs.source_zh: > 引领高阁上，绮疏遥相瞻。

paragraphs.source_en: > Looking back upon Lake Biwa, its limpid stillness is like a mirror.

units.source_en: > Looking back upon Lake Biwa, its limpid stillness is like a mirror.
units.source_zh: > 回望琵琶湖，澄澄静如鉴。

paragraphs.source_zh: > 回望琵琶湖，澄澄静如鉴。

paragraphs.source_en: > The labor spent astonishes heart and eye; its ingenious form defies all telling.

units.source_en: > The labor spent astonishes heart and eye; its ingenious form defies all telling.
units.source_zh: > 殚功骇心目，形巧难尽言。

paragraphs.source_zh: > 殚功骇心目，形巧难尽言。

paragraphs.source_en: > Its towers attain the height of artistry; one sighs that they might endure a hundred years.

units.source_en: > Its towers attain the height of artistry; one sighs that they might endure a hundred years.
units.source_zh: > 楼观穷精妙，长叹终百年。

paragraphs.source_zh: > 楼观穷精妙，长叹终百年。

paragraphs.source_en: Meanwhile, Ogaki Castle too was tottering under Mizuno Katsushige's fierce assault. Thus the beautiful vision Ishida Mitsunari had so carefully painted vanished into the void, having done nothing but mercilessly claim countless lives and leave behind a trail of the ugly claw marks of conspiracy...

units.source_en: Meanwhile, Ogaki Castle too was tottering under Mizuno Katsushige's fierce assault.

units.source_en: Thus the beautiful vision Ishida Mitsunari had so carefully painted vanished into the void, having done nothing but mercilessly claim countless lives and leave behind a trail of the ugly claw marks of conspiracy...
units.source_zh: 至此，石田三成精心描绘的美好图景，除了无情地带走无数人的性命，只留下一串串阴谋的丑陋爪痕，就在虚空中消失无踪……

paragraphs.source_zh: 同时，大垣城也在水野胜成的猛攻下风雨飘摇。至此，石田三成精心描绘的美好图景，除了无情地带走无数人的性命，只留下一串串阴谋的丑陋爪痕，就在虚空中消失无踪……

paragraphs.source_en: Where had Ishida Mitsunari, the man who brought about this great tragedy, fled? And what was he thinking?

units.source_en: Where had Ishida Mitsunari, the man who brought about this great tragedy, fled?
units.source_zh: 导致这场大悲剧的石田三成，究竟逃到了何处？

units.source_en: And what was he thinking?
units.source_zh: 他又在想什么？

paragraphs.source_zh: 导致这场大悲剧的石田三成，究竟逃到了何处？他又在想什么？

paragraphs.source_en: On the night of the fifteenth, when Mitsunari fled to Mount Ibuki, only a little over twenty retainers remained with him.

units.source_en: On the night of the fifteenth, when Mitsunari fled to Mount Ibuki, only a little over twenty retainers remained with him.
units.source_zh: 十五日夜，当三成逃到伊吹山时，从者只二十余人。

paragraphs.source_zh: 十五日夜，当三成逃到伊吹山时，从者只二十余人。

paragraphs.source_en: The cold autumn rain beat ceaselessly upon this wretched band. Water poured pitilessly into their armor, and the cold devoured them all. One guard somehow procured a straw rain cape and draped it over Mitsunari, but even that could not shield him from the penetrating rain.

units.source_en: The cold autumn rain beat ceaselessly upon this wretched band.
units.source_zh: 冰冷的秋雨不断打击着这群落魄之人。

units.source_en: Water poured pitilessly into their armor, and the cold devoured them all.
units.source_zh: 雨水无情地灌进盔甲中，寒冷吞噬着众人。

units.source_en: One guard somehow procured a straw rain cape and draped it over Mitsunari, but even that could not shield him from the penetrating rain.

ja.t: ぐことはできなかった。

units.source_zh: 一个侍卫不知从何处弄来一件蓑衣给三成披上，即便如此，亦无法抵御寒雨的侵袭。

paragraphs.source_zh: 冰冷的秋雨不断打击着这群落魄之人。雨水无情地灌进盔甲中，寒冷吞噬着众人。一个侍卫不知从何处弄来一件蓑衣给三成披上，即便如此，亦无法抵御寒雨的侵袭。

paragraphs.source_en: When the eastern sky paled on the sixteenth, the party was still staggering through the icy rain. Filled with fear, they fled without knowing which way to turn. During the war in Korea, Mitsunari, serving as an inspector, had ordered deserters severely punished—even the relatives of fugitives were to receive no mercy—and now he himself had fallen to such a state...

units.source_en: When the eastern sky paled on the sixteenth, the party was still staggering through the icy rain.
units.source_zh: 十六日东方泛白时，一行人还在冰冷的雨中蹒跚而行。

units.source_en: Filled with fear, they fled without knowing which way to turn.
units.source_zh: 他们满怀恐惧，慌不择路。

units.source_en: During the war in Korea, Mitsunari, serving as an inspector, had ordered deserters severely punished—even the relatives of fugitives were to receive no mercy—and now he himself had fallen to such a state...
units.source_zh: 征朝战争时，身为监军的三成下令，严惩逃兵，甚至连脱逃者的亲人都要严惩不贷，而如今，他竟也沦落到如此地步……

paragraphs.source_zh: 十六日东方泛白时，一行人还在冰冷的雨中蹒跚而行。他们满怀恐惧，慌不择路。征朝战争时，身为监军的三成下令，严惩逃兵，甚至连脱逃者的亲人都要严惩不贷，而如今，他竟也沦落到如此地步……

paragraphs.source_en: Cold, hunger, exhaustion, drowsiness... In a single night, he tasted every misery the world could offer. As the darkness slowly receded, the bedraggled Mitsunari could no longer concern himself with duty or human ties, vanity or appearances.

units.source_en: Cold, hunger, exhaustion, drowsiness... In a single night, he tasted every misery the world could offer.
units.source_zh: 寒冷、饥饿、疲劳、困倦……一夜之间，他尝尽了人间苦难。

units.source_en: As the darkness slowly receded, the bedraggled Mitsunari could no longer concern himself with duty or human ties, vanity or appearances.
units.source_zh: 当夜色渐渐褪去，狼狈的三成再也顾不上什么义理人情、虚荣体面了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 寒冷、饥饿、疲劳、困倦……一夜之间，他尝尽了人间苦难。当夜色渐渐褪去，狼狈的三成再也顾不上什么义理人情、虚荣体面了。

paragraphs.source_en: “Where are we going?” When Obata Sukerokurō, who had been following close behind, asked in bewilderment, Mitsunari replied, “Need you ask? Osaka!”

units.source_en: “Where are we going?”
units.source_zh: “我们要到哪里去？”

units.source_zh: 当一直跟在身后的小幡助六郎迷茫地问起时，三成答道：“那还用问？

units.source_en: Osaka!”

paragraphs.source_zh: “我们要到哪里去？”当一直跟在身后的小幡助六郎迷茫地问起时，三成答道：“那还用问？大坂！”

paragraphs.source_en: Though he answered thus, the words sat most uneasily within him. Sawayama Castle must already be surrounded so tightly that there was no hope of saving a single member of his clan, young or old, man or woman. Mitsunari knew full well that matters would come to this, and so he had not said they were going to Sawayama. Yet neither had he ever imagined that they could reach Osaka safely.

units.source_en: Though he answered thus, the words sat most uneasily within him.

ja.t: にはひどいわだかまりがあった。

units.source_zh: 尽管嘴上这么回答，可他内心却大为别扭。

units.source_en: Sawayama Castle must already be surrounded so tightly that there was no hope of saving a single member of his clan, young or old, man or woman.

ja.t: うすべはないはずだった。

units.source_zh: 佐和山城定已被围得水泄不通，一族男女老少皆无法解救。

ja.t: はそうなることをよく

units.source_zh: 三成深知会出现这种局面，故未说要去佐和山。

units.source_en: Yet neither had he ever imagined that they could reach Osaka safely.
units.source_zh: 只是，他也从未想过能平安赶到大坂。

paragraphs.source_zh: 尽管嘴上这么回答，可他内心却大为别扭。佐和山城定已被围得水泄不通，一族男女老少皆无法解救。三成深知会出现这种局面，故未说要去佐和山。只是，他也从未想过能平安赶到大坂。

paragraphs.source_en: “Let us rest awhile.” Mitsunari was too exhausted to walk another step. Finding an ancient pine, he dropped heavily onto its roots, then took out some ears of rice he had plucked along the road and silently began rubbing the grains free. Ieyasu strictly forbade the eating of raw rice, yet it had become Mitsunari's only means of filling his belly.

units.source_en: “Let us rest awhile.”
units.source_zh: “先歇一歇。”

units.source_en: Mitsunari was too exhausted to walk another step.
units.source_zh: 三成已累得走不动了。

units.source_en: Ieyasu strictly forbade the eating of raw rice, yet it had become Mitsunari's only means of filling his belly.

paragraphs.source_en: Mitsunari silently chewed the raw rice. His followers imitated him and earnestly began husking their own ears of grain.

units.source_zh: 随从们也学着他的样子，认真剥起谷穗来。

paragraphs.source_zh: 三成默默咀嚼着生米。随从们也学着他的样子，认真剥起谷穗来。

paragraphs.source_en: Strangely, not one of the twenty-odd men offered Mitsunari any of the grains he had husked. When death draws near, human beings reveal themselves with such stark honesty! At first, reason told them that they must protect their lord, but the life each had to preserve before all else was his own...

units.source_en: Strangely, not one of the twenty-odd men offered Mitsunari any of the grains he had husked.
units.source_zh: 不可思议的是，二十余人竟无一人把自己剥出来的米粒献给三成。

units.source_en: When death draws near, human beings reveal themselves with such stark honesty!

ja.t: はこれほどまでにありのままの

units.source_zh: 在濒临死亡之时，人便是如此真实！
